questions.question: What sin did the Jews in Egypt persist in, per chapter 44?
options: Marrying the women of the Egyptians
Burning incense to the queen of heaven and other gods
Breaking the Sabbath and the feasts
Stubbornly refusing to pay the tithes owed to the priests
questions.answer: Burning incense to the queen of heaven and other gods

questions.question: How did the people defiantly respond to Jeremiah?
options: They begged and pleaded with Jeremiah to pray for them
They repented at last and turned back again to the LORD
They returned to the land of Judah again at once
They refused and kept worshiping the queen of heaven
questions.answer: They refused and kept worshiping the queen of heaven

questions.question: Jeremiah warned that the Jews in Egypt would be consumed by sword and famine.
We will do everything we have vowed, make offerings to the queen of _____.
This was the sign that God would punish them: Pharaoh _____ would be given into the hand of his enemies.
